sections.text: You're listening to the Skeptics' Guide to the Universe, your escape to reality.
sections.title: Introduction

sections.text: OMG, I found this rubbish on a crowd funding website, they have raised $17,197 towards this project!!! Can you believe it?Make it stop!!http://www.indiegogo.com/projects/home-quantum-energy-generator Ok I vented, I’m done!John DawsonPerth Western Australia

Item #1: A new study finds that beauty sleep is real – patients who were treated for poor sleep were rated as more attractive following treatment.
Item #2: Researchers find that cats infected with the toxoplasma parasite are more affectionate and likely to lick other animals, including humans, increasing the spread of the parasite.
Item #3: Scientists have discovered a method for converting mature skin cells into stem cells with near perfect efficiency by removing a single protein.
sections.title: Science or Fiction

sections.text: 'No No. Be of good cheer. If science teaches us anything, it teaches us to accept our failures, as well as our successes, with quiet dignity and grace.'- Dr. Frederick Frankenstein
